scope: Authored Chinese text-only local inference; no actual acoustic recognition, OCR capture or automatic scene detection.
diagnosis: Different spellings are normal for ASR correction, not by themselves a factual conflict.
Conservative preservation can suppress supported repair; missing code-boundary and ordinary-homophone demonstrations limit coverage.
Context-only instructions/facts and nonmatching or ambiguous spellings are distinct negative controls.
Causal attribution is limited: policy/example edits are a combined treatment, and prompt-only logic has no reliable OCR confidence metadata.

dev.selection: Review all development raw/cleanup outputs. Prioritize intended-message fidelity, supported repair and no harmful context overwrite, then natural organization. Freeze the diagnostic choice before fresh evaluation; do not promote a failed candidate.

evaluation.baseline: The frozen no-validator-v1 anchored prompt in every scene, not the installed production template.
evaluation.note: Fresh semantic challenge types are related to earlier development; no independent content-family/speaker claim.

review: Inspect every raw proposal and cleanup against evaluator-only intended text. Count successful/missed required repair, wrong/context overwrites, omitted clauses and style/envelope separately. Show every assigned/effective scene and actual template version.
acceptance: Improve required repair without introducing new harmful delivery, retaining all restrictions/intent and proportional scene organization. Independent natural-data/native release gates remain open.
